caveats: These are source-reference feeds, not completed translations.
These are not source-fidelity certification, native-speaker approval, terminology approval, language synchronization proof, or critical editions.
The Slavic/Interslavic bundle includes generated Noether Russian/Ukrainian/Interslavic support TeX; those files are internal consistency support, not native-source attestation.

The 2026-07-05 Slavic arXiv addendum is useful source-body evidence for Slavic/interlanguage computational-linguistics methodology, but it does not close the missing native mathematical TeX corpus for individual non-Russian/non-Ukrainian Slavic languages.
Other AI lanes should continue collecting actual source-body LaTeX files for thin language families and push the file bodies, not only ledgers.
